_comment_tim_3450: numberOfRuns was 1. A single un-medianed Lighthouse run on a shared CI
runner is noisy enough to fail a 0.85 performance bar by chance, and it
did: four PRs in one week went red on this job with no relevant code
change, and every one of them passed on a re-run. Each false red cost a
full investigation to rule out a real regression.
Three runs with an explicit median makes the assertion describe the
typical load rather than whichever one happened to land on a busy box.
Median, not 'optimistic': we want the normal experience to clear the bar,
not the best of three. The thresholds themselves are unchanged, so this
loosens nothing about what counts as acceptable.
NOT fixed here: the job sometimes dies during collect and writes no
report at all. That is the 'wait-on tcp:3000' race in smoke.yml, which
only proves the port is bound, not that Next is answering. Fixing it
